quote: After the establishment of a speed zone and the installation of appropriate signs to control speed, it is unlawful for any person to drive a motor vehicle upon the road and in the speed zone in excess of the speed therein authorized.

activation.description: Prior establishment and appropriate installed speed-control signs on the governed road and direction.
activation.source_clause: After the establishment of a speed zone and the installation of appropriate signs to control speed

obligation.description: Measure motor-vehicle speed during signed-zone occupancy against the independently sourced authorized value; reserve legal conclusion.
obligation.source_clause: in the speed zone in excess of the speed therein authorized

timing.description: Original Native speed is joined to each frame inside reviewed zone boundaries; no invented grace period.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Prior administrative establishment must come from an independent source.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: installation of appropriate signs to control speed
judgment_calls_needed.note: Installed sign face, appropriateness and direction require independent original review.
Applicable authorized value is source-read; measured excess is not a synthetic legal verdict.
